# Exported struct fields production code reads and never writes.
# Generated by: go run ./cmd/tools/audit_dark_fields -update
#
# A field here always reads as its zero value. That is not an error, it does
# not log, and it is indistinguishable from a legitimate "nothing to report",
# which is why every instance of this found so far was found by hand.
#
# Entries are TYPE.FIELD with the declaration site. Before adding one, decide
# which of two things it is, because they look identical from the reader:
#   a missing WIRE   - a producer exists and nothing connects it. Fix it.
#   a missing SOURCE - nothing in this architecture can answer. Say so at
#                      the field, and cost the producer as a feature.
#
# A line marked (dead file) declares the field in a file that also has
# entries in the dead-code budget. Those fields are usually dark BECAUSE
# nothing calls the functions that would fill them — triage them last.
